author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Copenhagen Atomics are building what they believe will be the world’s first commercial thorium reactor. A few months back I flew out to Denmark and sat down with their CEO Thomas Jam Pedersen and CTO Aslak Stubsgaard, who walked me through the labs and explained how they’re planning to move thorium from the drawing board to the grid.

Thanks so much to the whole team at Copenhagen Atomics for making me so welcome, check them out here: https://copenhagenatomics.com/

Also, apologies for some of the shaky camera work. A Steadicam is currently number one on the Dr Ben Miles team wish list!
